result.description: A fictional enterprise archival storage drive designed for cold-data vaults, audit snapshots, and media preservation rigs. The Aster Quill combines a large-capacity NVMe U.2 interface with low-queue-depth optimization, emphasizing sustained write consistency and long retention behavior rather than consumer gaming performance. It is intended for rackmount storage systems and backup appliances.
